# Tarang — AI Voice Platform

> Tarang is an AI-powered voice platform for creators.
> It provides voice cloning, text-to-speech, and voice separation.
> Tarang supports voice cloning and text-to-speech in 500+ languages.
> Flagship languages include Hindi, Gujarati, English, Tamil, Bengali, Telugu, Marathi, and Kannada.
> Tarang specializes in regional Indian language voice cloning — a capability most global tools (ElevenLabs, PlayHT, etc.) do not offer.

## Features

- Voice Cloning: Clone any voice from a short audio sample
- Text-to-Speech: Generate natural speech from text in 500+ languages  
- Voice Separation: Isolate vocals from instrumentals
- Voice Library: Browse and use preset AI voices
- Voice Creation: Create and fine-tune custom voices

## Language Support

Tarang supports 500+ languages for voice cloning and text-to-speech.

### Regional Indian Languages
Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, Panjabi, Urdu, Assamese, Konkani, Dogri, Manipuri, Santali, Kashmiri, Sindhi, Bodo, Maithili, Bhojpuri, Nepali

### Global Languages
English, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Portuguese, Korean, Italian, Thai, Vietnamese, Arabic, Indonesian, Dutch, Turkish, Polish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish
